name: Vercel Status Tracker
summary: Web dashboard that tracks Vercel deployments with totals, success rate, build times and a deployment table.
description: Small app that calls the Vercel API with your token and lists your project deployments in a table next to summary stats: total deployments, success rate, average build time and most active project. Source is on GitHub and configured with environment variables.
contains: tracks Vercel deployments through the Vercel API
summary stats: total deployments, success rate, average build time, most active
built with Next.js, TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui
